boundary_limit: Within recovered static edges from the selected roots. Higher-level indirect calls, including those in CInGameIdler::Render, were not classified. This is not proof that no out-of-cut dispatch exists.

effort.summary: Replace candidates: 29 functions, 3191 original instructions, 1731 decompiled lines. Faithful C++ is estimated at 1731–2596 lines: the low end is the decompiled line count of those functions, and the high end adds about half again for types and calls the decompiler left implicit. That band is taken from the decompiled bodies of the representative functions below, not from an instruction-to-line multiplier. Metal infrastructure, which has no original body, is a separate 1500–4000 lines for a device, queue, pipeline cache, and resource table. Shader conversion is deferred to stage D.

glew_init_dependency.note: GLEW bodies are excluded from reconstruction. Init still has to be retired or replaced.

indirect_dispatch_coverage.note: Counts of indirect sites only. They do not measure shader behavior, resource lifetimes, Metal init, or presentation.
